title: mirabilis nyctaginea
intro: Mirabilis nyctaginea, commonly known as Night-Blooming Four O'Clock, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis nyctaginea include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which can help in soothing skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
